sections.title: ABOUT ME
content:
I start every design process by uncovering the \textbf{question} that can move the business forward.

With 2+ years across product design, computer science, and customer-facing sales, I bring a practical understanding of how people think, decide, and build trust. I believe design should solve real problems, build confidence, and create business value. I use AI within a structured design process to explore, test, and iterate faster, reserving my attention for decisions that require human judgment, creativity, and empathy.

entries.title: Sales Associate (Educator) | KIT+ACE, Part-time | Calgary
content: Delivered premium customer experiences by translating technical product details into accessible, personalized value, driving purchase confidence and repeat visits
Took ownership of floor operations including merchandising standards, inventory accuracy, and onboarding support, contributing to a consistently excellent in-store experience
Supported customers who preferred an in-person experience or found online filters, size guides, and product pages cumbersome by patiently walking them through tailored options
\textbf{Ranked in the top 10 salespeople across all 15 KIT+ACE locations in Canada} in both months of employment, within weeks of joining the team
